title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on St. White
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale with a separate annex on the edge of Bardhyl street, on the small ring road. The certified area of ​​the apartment is 64.2m², the real area is 72m². They are located on the last 4th floor of the existing building. Isolated terrace. It is also sold on credit, restored and custom furnished with quality equipment. The price is 147,000 euros
